title: The Goonies
note: mentioned during Sicario ep as a possible candidate for CR month; was one of the finalists for the final movie of CR month
plot: Young teen Mikey Walsh and his friends set off on a quest to find Pirate One-Eyed Willie's treasure in hopes of saving their homes from demolition. However, on their quest to find the treasure, they run into a family of recently escaped criminals, determined to capture the kids and reach the treasure first.
